card.capacity_status_quote: Even as demand across our customer base remains exceptionally strong and continues to accelerate, the unprecedented growth throughout the data center ecosystem has created a tighter supplier environment, effectively pacing our growth.
card.demand_direction_quote: We continue to see exceptionally strong and accelerating demand from our hyperscaler customer base complemented by a steadily strengthening outlook in our ATS segment.
card.pricing_power_quote: it really has nothing to do with pricing because capacity is at a premium. Our execution is a real differentiator. And so we have choice on where we apply our focus. And so we are not giving up price in the marketplace.
card.guidance_direction_quote: we are raising our full year 2026 annual financial outlook. We are raising our revenue outlook from $17 billion to $19 billion, representing very strong growth of 53%.
card.constraint_owner_quote: The constrained commodities right now on allocation are custom silicon and memory.
